content: The customer, Reyansh Tiwari, called to discuss his auto insurance policy, which was cancelled due to two missed payments caused by bank issues. The insurance agent, Suresh Deshmukh, offered a reinstatement option through a payment plan. The customer agreed to pay $500 by the end of the week to reinstate the policy, and the agent agreed to send a confirmation email with the details.

action_items: Make a payment of $500 by the end of the week to reinstate the policy
Send a confirmation email with details to the customer
